Seafood and fun run by a family
Apr 2013 • Solo
I have been eating at Van Anh for several and the food is always good. The service provided by the family and their friends and is attentive and active. Four generations of the family run the resturant and it shows in the quality. They prepare a wide variety of seafood by grilling, steaming, frying, and serving it raw. The menu há pictures and some english but no prices--you probably should ask before selecting. Beer í cold and served with a smile. You probably will only see locals here, but it is a good experience in what used to be a street devoted to seafood. Only a few remain and Van Anh is the bét.

good seafood prepared by a large family
Jan 2013 • Business
Van Anh is one of the last grea seafood restaurants on To Hien Thanh, the seafood street in the French district. This restaurant is run by a multigeneration family and serve excellent live seafood prepared steamed, grilled, and other ways. The seafood is live, clean, and, of course, fresh. The shrimp are excellent prepared many ways, and the large crabs are great. The kids serve and create a fun atmosphere They crack crabs and make sure you have everything you needo eat your food including a variety of sauces. The food is not cheap but is reasonable and priced for Vietnamese customers. Some English is spoken and the menu has English and Vietnamese. It is easiest to just point to what you want. This is a fun way to experience Vetnamese dining and you will be joined by families, couples, and groups of locals. Foreigners are rare but welcome.. Beer is cold and cheap and there are vegetables available to complete your meal.
